_README: OPTIONAL, COMMUNITY, UNOFFICIAL — an MCP server pointed at a locally-running floci (https://floci.io) AWS emulator. floci itself ships NO MCP server (verified); its recommended AI path is the env-var contract in docs/Floci.md, NOT this. Use this only if you specifically want an MCP tool surface.
_WARNING: The '@yawlabs/aws-mcp' package below is THIRD-PARTY and NOT a floci product (floci ships no MCP server). Pin a specific version and review it before use. It must be installed first (npm i -g @yawlabs/aws-mcp) and launched via `node` with an ABSOLUTE path to dist/index.js — `npx` reportedly breaks its stdio. Replace <ABSOLUTE_PATH> accordingly.
_usage: Start floci first: `floci start` (AWS on http://localhost:4566). Then merge the `servers` block below into your workspace .vscode/mcp.json (VS Code) and reload.
